page_title: ELC 2-1 CEL | Elche v Celta Vigo 28/09/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+7' Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out.
90+4' Celta Vigo couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Matias Dituro (Elche) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
90+3' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defending players intercepts the effort and the danger passes.
90+2' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Elche was in an offside position.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
85' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) gives the referee no choice but to show him a yellow card.
84' The attendance for today's match is 26708.
84' Celta Vigo concede a free kick after one of their players holds onto an opposition player. Elche win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
82' That's the end of the game for Marcos Alonso, who is replaced by Manuel Fernandez (Celta Vigo).
81' Eder Sarabia has decided to make a change. Marc Aguado (Elche) replaces Josan.
81' It's time for a substitution. Grady Diangana (Elche) comes on in place of Rafa Mir.
81' Rafa Mir (Elche) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Guillermo Cuadra blows his whistle for a foul.
80' The linesman points to the corner flag, Elche are going to take it.
80' Rafa Mir (Elche) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
79' Elche are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
76' It’s hot out there so the ref signals there will be a cooling break for the players to take on some fluids.
73' Eder Sarabia prepares a substitution. Pedro Bigas is replaced by Victor Chust (Elche).
73' Claudio Giraldez has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) replacing Yoel Lago.
73' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Adria Pedrosa trots off the pitch and is replaced by Leo Petrot (Elche).
72' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
70' David Affengruber (Elche) is punished with a yellow card for violating the rules.
68' 2 - 1 Goal! John Donald (Elche) fires the rebound into the top right corner after the ball breaks to him in the box. The score is 2:1.
67' Claudio Giraldez has decided to substitute Bryan Zaragoza and he is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
66' Ionut Radu makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded towards the bottom left corner by Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche).
64' Josan (Elche) is awarded a yellow card. The referee showed him no mercy.
64' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Alvaro Rodriguez (Elche) will replace Andre Silva.
63' Elche take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
63' Rafa Mir (Elche) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away.
61' Adria Pedrosa (Elche) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
60' Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
57' Yoel Lago (Celta Vigo) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
57' The game is interrupted. One of the players from Celta Vigo is cautioned for aggressive play. A free kick has been awarded to Elche.
54' Rafa Mir (Elche) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu pulls off a superb save.
53' Here comes the VAR decision. YES, it's a penalty!
53' Referee Guillermo Cuadra makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Elche. Let’s see what happens!
51' Surely that's handball by one of the Celta Vigo players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
51' German Valera (Elche) takes the corner with a short pass.
49' David Affengruber (Elche) sends a promising through ball, but the defence is alert and cuts out the pass.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) and Oscar Mingueza is off.
46' The game is over for Ilaix Moriba. Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) comes on for the second half.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+4' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Elche comes to nothing.
45+3' None of the Elche players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
45+1' Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Guillermo Cuadra saw the whole situation.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' German Valera (Elche) rises high to meet a cross on the edge of the 6-yard box and powers his header on goal, but the goalkeeper shows his agility and makes a save.
41' A lofted cross from John Donald (Elche) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area.
39' John Donald (Elche) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
38' Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
35' German Valera (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
33' The ball is laid off to Bryan Zaragoza (Celta Vigo) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the bottom right corner and forces Matias Dituro to make a decent save.
32' The ball is cleared after Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
30' A cooling break is underway.
28' Elche seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
25' It's a throw-in for Elche.
22' 1 - 1 Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) receives the ball inside the box, reacts quickly and without any problems stabs the ball low inside the left post.
21' Celta Vigo failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
18' 1 - 0 Andre Silva (Elche) receives a delightful pass inside the box and smashes a low shot into the bottom left corner. What a clinical finish!
17' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card for infringement.
15' Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) leaps like a salmon and powers a header in at goal from the corner, but his close-range effort is poor and goes way over the bar.
15' Celta Vigo have been awarded a corner kick.
14' A lofted pass into the box is met by Rafa Mir (Elche), who rifles a shot just wide of the left post.
13' Elche force their opponents to concede a corner.
12' Andre Silva (Elche) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
10' John Donald (Elche) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
10' German Valera (Elche) collects a brilliant pass inside the box and finds himself in a goal scoring opportunity. He takes a shot, but the effort is well blocked by one of the defending players.
9' Elche have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
7' Hugo Sotelo (Celta Vigo) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
6' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
4' What a big chance! Miguel Roman (Celta Vigo) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
2' Andre Silva (Elche) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
1' The first half has started.
Elche will kick the game off.
Guillermo Cuadra is introduced as the referee for today's match.
